subject: business-management
title: Business Management — Second Partial (Midterm 2)
note: Part I follows Exercise 4 of the course's example exam (twenty True/False statements, +0.15 right, −0.15 wrong, 0 blank, 3 points, no answer accepted without its reasoning). The example exam has no multiple-choice part: Part II (8 questions, +0.25 / −0.08 / 0, 2 points) is a practice format of the portal. Part III is two problems or cases of different types, 2.5 points each, in the style of Exercises 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 of the example exam (Topic 7 cases are written for the portal). The example exam prints no duration; 90 minutes is the standard here.

Exercises 7 and 8 (financial statements, Topic 3 Part I) are outside Midterm 2.

provenance.verify_when: An official Midterm 2 paper of the current course is added under sources/cuatrimestre-1/05-business-management/examenes/; update this file to match it and drop this note.

content_scope_source: Topic 3 Part II (investment selection: sheet 3_II_NPV IRR.pdf and its solutions), Topic 4 (production function), Topic 5 (marketing and sales), Topic 6 (management function), Topic 7 (entrepreneurship and innovation).

parts.label: Part I — True / False statements
parts.description: Twenty independent statements: true (T) or false (F), each with a short written reason. In the exam no answer counts as right without its reasoning.

parts.label: Part II — Multiple choice
parts.description: Eight questions with four options and one right answer.

parts.label: Part III — Problems and cases
parts.description: Two problems or cases of different types: investment selection, break-even and leverage, or a marketing, management or innovation case.
parts.grading: per subquestion, using the points of each subquestion (they add up to 2.5)

modes.label: Full Midterm 2 exam
modes.description: The whole simulated exam: 20 True/False statements, 8 multiple-choice questions and 2 problems or cases, timed, graded out of 10.

modes.label: True / False practice
modes.description: Only True/False statements, from the units you tick, spread evenly over them. Timed and graded at the end, or corrected as you answer.

modes.label: Multiple-choice practice
modes.description: Only multiple-choice questions, from the units you tick, spread evenly over them. Timed and graded at the end, or corrected as you answer.

modes.label: Problems and cases practice
modes.description: Only problems and cases, of the types you tick, timed and graded part by part with the key results.
